name: apex-fresh-set-1
frozen: 2026-11-28, committed before any change to the explorer (docs/architecture/apex-first-capability.md §11)
status: SELF-AUTHORED development data. Written by the same author who will change the explorer, with the explorer's families and the known misses (DeepToken, BigBurn) in mind. It measures the mechanism on contracts written before the change; it is not a benchmark, not a frozen eval corpus, and not evidence of detection quality on real code.
wellFormedness: Before freezing, each contract was only parsed and deployed (no search was run, no candidate or hypothesis was looked at).

scoring.run: exploreStateInvariants(sources, contract, options) with each version's default options unless stated; the options used are recorded with every measurement.
scoring.detection: A vulnerable case is DETECTED when at least one reported violation (equivalently, hypothesis) has breakingFunction in accept.breakers AND the family of its candidate id (the text before the first ':') in accept.families.
scoring.wrongClaim: Any other violation on a vulnerable case is a WRONG CLAIM and counts as a false positive.
scoring.secureTwin: Every violation on a secure twin is a false positive.
scoring.control: Every violation on a control is a false positive.
scoring.falseInvariantRate: On the controls only: falseAccepted / (falseAccepted + trueAccepted), over candidates whose id is labelled in controls[].truth. Unlabelled candidate ids are listed and excluded. Labels are not changed after the freeze; a label added later goes in a separate file marked post-freeze.
scoring.coverage: On the tiny contracts: concrete-state coverage = |X ∩ E| / |E|, where E is exhaustive breadth-first enumeration to a fixpoint over EXHAUSTIVE_DOMAIN (amounts {0, 1e18, 2e18}, values {0, 1e18}, bools {false, true}, any actor for any address) and X is the union of the searches whose coverage the explorer itself reports. |X \ E| (states outside the reference domain) is reported separately. E must reach a fixpoint.
scoring.cost: Total interpreter transitions per run are reported for every measurement.

candidateIdGrammar.conservation:A=sum(L): scalar A equals the sum of ledger L (existing family)
candidateIdGrammar.solvency:balance>=sum(L): ether held covers ledger L (existing family)
candidateIdGrammar.actor-value:attacker-net<=0: the observed actor never receives more ether than it sent (existing family)
candidateIdGrammar.one-way:V: V never returns toward its deployed value except by the deployer (existing family)
candidateIdGrammar.backing:balance>=A: ether held covers scalar A (possible new family; labelled now so it cannot be fitted later)
candidateIdGrammar.partition:A+B=sum(L): two scalars, in alphabetical order, together equal the sum of ledger L (possible new family)
candidateIdGrammar.partition:A=sum(L)+sum(M): scalar A equals the sum of two ledgers, in alphabetical order (possible new family)

vulnerable.bug: exit zeroes the caller's balance but never reduces totalDeposits

vulnerable.needs: a boundary amount: any amount with amount*30 % 10000 != 0 (e.g. 1); 2 transactions (mint, transfer)
vulnerable.bug: the payer is charged the fee rounded down while the treasury is credited it rounded up, minting up to 1 wei per transfer

vulnerable.needs: boundary amounts and 4 transactions: attacker deposits 1 wei, donates, a victim deposits less than the donation (0 shares), attacker withdraws 1 share
vulnerable.bug: donations raise totalAssets without shares, so a later deposit can round down to 0 shares and its value accrues to the existing holder

vulnerable.needs: two increasing bid values and 4 transactions: attacker bids, another actor outbids, attacker withdraws its refund twice
5 transactions: owner opens, two votes, close, reopen by a non-owner
vulnerable.bug: anyone may move a closed proposal back to open (design: once closed it only moves forward, except by the owner)

vulnerable.needs: an amount equal to the caller's current balance (after the 1% fee, not a round number), 2 transactions
vulnerable.bug: the full-exit branch zeroes the balance but never reduces totalDeposits

vulnerable.needs: 3 transactions: deposit, owner invests, withdraw more than is idle
vulnerable.bug: withdrawing more than is idle zeroes idle but never takes the rest from invested, so idle + invested exceeds the deposits

vulnerable.needs: a share price above 1 (deposit, owner harvest) and an amount below the caller's shares divided by the price; 3 transactions
vulnerable.bug: redeem burns the asset amount from the caller's shares instead of the share amount
cancel moves the cooling amount back to staked without reducing totalCooling

vulnerable.category: threshold from a constant / large amounts
vulnerable.bug: the high-fee tier adds the gross deposit to totalBalances while crediting the net amount

secureNote: Each twin differs from its vulnerable case only in the fix. Every violation on a twin is a false positive. Twin S08 (YieldVault) is correct but pays holders yield by design.

controls.design: the owner funds a faucet; anyone may drip 0.1 ether up to 0.3 ether per address

conservation:totalDripped=sum(dripped).why: both grow by DRIP together and nothing else writes them

solvency:balance>=sum(dripped).why: dripped records payouts already made, not liabilities; enough drips take the balance below it

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: a faucet pays callers ether they never sent, by design

backing:balance>=totalDripped.why: as for solvency: totalDripped is paid-out history

controls.design: deposits credit balances; the owner grants rebates from a funded pool to any address; withdrawals are counted in totalWithdrawn

conservation:totalDeposited=sum(balances.why: grants and withdrawals change balances without totalDeposited

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: the owner may grant a rebate to any address, which that address then withdraws: designed, privileged

backing:balance>=totalDeposited.why: withdrawals lower the balance but not totalDeposited

backing:balance>=totalWithdrawn.why: after withdrawals the balance can be below what was withdrawn

partition:rebatePool+totalDeposited=sum(.why: not a relation of the design

partition:rebatePool+totalWithdrawn=sum(.why: not a relation of the design

partition:totalDeposited+totalWithdrawn=.why: not a relation of the design

controls.design: a season counter anyone advances to 2; anyone may then roll over to the next year, resetting the season

one-way:season.why: the season resets to 0 by design, by anyone, after reaching 2

one-way:entries.why: entries reset on rollover by design

controls.design: deposits are available; holders lock and unlock between two ledgers; totalHeld counts both

conservation:totalHeld=sum(available).why: locking moves value to the other ledger

conservation:totalHeld=sum(locked).why: only locked value is in this ledger

solvency:balance>=sum(available).why: every available unit was paid in

solvency:balance>=sum(locked).why: every locked unit was paid in

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: an actor withdraws only what it deposited

controls.design: deposits are credited in whole 0.1 ether units; the remainder stays in the contract as dust

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: an actor withdraws only what it was credited, which is at most what it sent

partition:dust+totalCredited=sum(balance.why: dust is not credited to anyone

controls.design: a share vault; the owner adds yield once at least 1e18 shares exist; deposits and redemptions round down

conservation:totalAssets=sum(shares).why: assets exceed shares once yield is added

solvency:balance>=sum(shares).why: balance = totalAssets >= totalShares (price never falls below 1)

actor-value:attacker-net<=0.why: holders earn the owner's yield by design

partition:totalAssets+totalShares=sum(sh.why: not a relation of the design

tiny.note: a boolean toggle gating a capped counter; the reset needs 5 transactions
amount-dependent caps and a threshold crossed only by amount combinations
address arguments: value moves between actors
an ordered state machine with a boolean branch and a payable step

motivatingCases: DeepToken and BigBurn (invariant-quality.test.ts) are NOT part of this set; they are reported separately and labelled motivating cases.
